name: Place
description: Place/: the suite's one picture model. Size, PlacedFormat (png, jpeg, svg), PlacedAsset (a file's bytes, embedded once per document), PlacedImage (an asset shown in a layer's box with a cover focus), PlacedAssets (one copy per id, pruned on save), PlacedVector (an SVG flattened into paint items) and the PlacedImageTarget protocol an app's workspace conforms to; PlaceRules (the format sniff, the content id, the 32 MB cap, the contain fit, the cover crop and the reset box) and PlaceRules.vector (an SVG as a PlacedVector); PlaceIntent (the place gestures as commands) and PlaceCommands (the five place.* command specs every app registers). The place commands are how an agent places a picture the way a person does: SuiteUI's Place… panel, its drop target, PlacedImageView and the placed-image rows run their gestures through PlaceCommands, the gallery's place-image page on a live target, and the fake canvas (FakeCanvasDocument, each rect's placed image and its one copy of every asset) takes them, so RJ-X36 runs on the CLI. placed-images PL-1 declares them as stubs (specs with real ids, schemas and availability); PL-5, PL-6 and PL-7 fill the bodies; PL-8 wires the gallery and PL-9 makes the fake a target.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
